_meta.purpose: Location-aware shopping substitutes for The Cape Table. Keyed by the exact ingredient-name text as it appears in a recipe's Shop tab (before the quantity). Looked up by the app when a visitor's stored country has an entry below.

status_meanings.native: Already a native/mainstream product in that country -- nothing to substitute, buy it as named.
status_meanings.specialty: The real South African product is orderable there, usually via a specialty importer -- an everyday supermarket alternative is also given for anyone who'd rather not order in.
status_meanings.everyday: An ordinary South African supermarket brand with no import route researched -- only a normal local-shelf equivalent is given.

_meta.pilot_note: Built 2026-08-28 from the 7 live Cape Table recipes, United Kingdom only. Reviewed by Koot before being wired into the app.
